claim_boundary: Deployment-ready research software for text-to-text integrity auditing; not a diagnostic, image-reading, autonomous clinical, or patient-outcome system.

caveats: The no-structured-rules model uses only TF-IDF/lexical retrieval features.
Rules-only probabilities are fixed confidence scores and are not calibrated estimates.
Controlled mutations are synthetic; entity substitutions may be clinically ambiguous.

files.distribution: Aggregate evidence only. Row-level predictions, report text, claims, evidence excerpts, and study identifiers are intentionally not bundled.

radevalx.label_provenance: Consensus error counts from two board-certified radiologists.
limitations: Consensus counts are report-level and do not provide claim-level NLI labels.
The reference report is treated as textual evidence; this is not image-grounded truth.
The cohort contains 100 reports from one report-generation system.
All related Open-I content groups were quarantined before training and model selection.
radevalx.task: clinically significant error detection and review prioritization

transfer_routing.score_semantics: ReXErr-trained transfer risk; not a radiologist probability

calibration.fit_dataset: ReXErr validation semantic errors and clean controls

files.distribution: Aggregate evidence only. Row-level predictions, report text, claims, evidence excerpts, and study identifiers are intentionally not bundled.

rexerr.label_provenance: Clinician-designed synthetic errors with post-hoc automated sentence labels; not radiologist factuality ground truth.
limitations: The error labels are synthetic/silver and include known alignment noise.
Lexical change is a strong shortcut in this constructed benchmark.
Linguistic-quality changes are reported separately from semantic clinical errors.

deceptive_identity_shortcut.purpose: shows why identity controls are excluded from primary metrics

files.distribution: Aggregate evidence only. Row-level predictions, report text, claims, evidence excerpts, and study identifiers are intentionally not bundled.

limitations: Injected errors are synthetic and report sampled-error fields can overstate successful insertions.
Only a small number of changed semantic-negative reports are available in validation and test.
Identity controls are reported only as invariance checks and are excluded from primary metrics.
The transfer score is trained on ReXErr and is not a radiologist-calibrated probability.
The report-level benchmark evaluates consistency against text, not image-grounded clinical truth.

transfer_router.fit_dataset: ReXErr train changed reports with post-hoc semantic labels
transfer_router.score_semantics: ReXErr-trained report transfer risk; not a radiologist probability

title: Reciprocal evidence auditing for radiology summaries

unlabelled_robustness.policy: No accuracy, agreement, or factuality score is reported without independent labels.
